The supplied artifact is strategically useful as a pressure-test draft, but it is not ready for external dispatch.

The artifact includes strong outreach language toward Sundar Pichai and Satya Nadella, frames multiple Microsoft/Google convergence lanes, and uses high-authority labels such as:

```text

Signal Locked
Finalized for Dispatch
STRATEGIC-MANDATE
ready for final dual-signing
```

These labels are not acceptable as evidence of authorization.

Not as:

